description: pin-in-bore-fuse's pin, touching the bore's wall from inside, moved across the contact by a quarter of a tolerance (1e-7), out through the wall (d > 0) and in off it (d < 0), and four in off it, fused: the bore's cylinder whole each time. Four out is pin-in-bore-four-out (plans/c3-tolerance-apart step 9, the band's ends).
